reviews.text: We have used Custom Pools for most of our company’s  pool resurfacing needs. This time we used them for our home pool. We love these  guys and highly recommend  them. They took a very old pool and made it new again!
reviews.author: Pat Johnson

reviews.text: Ted and Jill have been absolutely fantastic! From the very beginning, they were always quick to respond to our questions and kept us informed every step of the way. The quality of their work is top-notch, and it’s clear that they take pride in what they do. Without a doubt, we will be using them again for all our future needs. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable and outstanding service!
reviews.author: Sarah Ramirez

reviews.text:
I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND Custom Pool Plastering to anyone that wants to have their pool refinished.
My experience with their staff was nothing short of excellent. The process from start to finish and follow up after the work was complete has been awesome.

Ted, Jill, Justin and their team are solid, honest people. Do not get your pool redone without having a bid from Custom Pool Plastering.

Thank you Ted and everyone for a great experience and making our pool look amazing!!
reviews.author: Kevin France

reviews.text:
Working with Custom Pool Plastering was hands-down one of the best contractor experiences I’ve ever had. From start to finish, the entire process was actually fun — which, let’s be honest, is how a pool project should feel. Too often it turns into a stressful burden, but not with these folks.

From day one, I felt like more than just a customer — I felt like a close friend. I was treated with genuine respect, and most importantly, they set realistic expectations. No fluff, no over-promising. Just honest, clear communication. And that made all the difference.

We’ve all heard the horror stories — delays, silence, half-finished projects — but this team kept me in the loop every step of the way. Look, everyone wants their pool done yesterday, but any adult knows that weather, materials, and scheduling can shift. What mattered most to me was being updated as things progressed. That transparency made everything less stressful.

Now let’s talk about the final result: incredible. The craftsmanship is top-tier. A pool is more than just a backyard feature — it’s an investment, a retreat, a source of joy. And these guys treated it like that from day one. No cutting corners, no sloppy work, just experienced professionals who clearly care about what they do. The attention to detail is obvious, and now I feel like I’ve got a private resort right outside my door.

This is a family-owned and operated business, and it shows. They’ve been doing this for decades, and you can feel that experience in every phase — from design to execution to how they treat their clients. I wish every company I hired made me feel this taken care of.

Huge thanks to everyone at Custom Pool Plastering. I can’t recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Matthew Kraus

reviews.text: Custom Pools and the Davidsons did a beautiful job creating and building our pool. It is absolutely amazing ! We have a small yard and they had the vision and expertise to turn it into a resort like haven  We are in awe every day! We highly recommend  Custom Pools!
reviews.author: Bill Lexa

reviews.text:
The whole team at Custom Pools were such a pleasure to work with. Very honest and in-depth explanation of the whole process and Ted even took the time to explain some portions on my own pool system that I was unfamiliar with. 10/10 would recommend, and I’ll be a loyal customer for years to come.
Support small businesses and family owned companies!!
reviews.author: Mitch Thompson

reviews.text: Ted is a gem!  I have never seen someone care for clients and his team more!  He is the guy that will actually jump in on the job site!  He will not stop until the project is exactly as it should be and exceed expectations!  He also is cost conscious in pricing for you!  He is an absolute YES when choosing a pool company!
reviews.author: Chelsea Alexander

reviews.text: They do superior work.Honest trustworthy. On time. We have used them for years Great repair and replastering work. We highly recommend Ted and his team for any pool work
reviews.author: Lisa prude

reviews.text: Custom Pool Plastering did an incredible job on my pool!! Great service and value has them on the top of the list for any needs down the road! I highly recommend them!!
reviews.author: Jeff Gartland

reviews.text: Very pleased with the work performed by Custom Pool Plastering. All of the crew have a vast amount of experience and are " craftsmen".  I would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Pete Peach

reviews.text: I agree with the other review to "avoid this company at all costs."  We also had crack in pool and had pool resurfaced.  $35,000 later, and crack is still very visible, and we are wanting to put our house on the market.  They tried to fix it a couple of times and it's worse, and they stopped accepting calls.  Resurfacing process was a "nightmare" too as the work was not professional or supervised.  2 year warranty is a joke.  I don't like leaving bad reviews and tried for 2 years to see if they would honor their work but they didn't so I'm just warning others to go elsewhere for quality, service and professionalism.
reviews.author: Jeanie

reviews.text:
Ted is one of the best! He is very responsive and always available to help. I can't say enough good things about Ted.

I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Ed McKiernan

reviews.text: We highly recommend this company!  Our pool needed to be resurfaced and they did an outstanding job on the project.  From the beginning they were prompt with getting out to give us a quote and followed thru with examples of materials for pool.  The price they quoted was lower than other companies.  The crew was on time, workers very professional, and the finished product is just what we wanted.  We will definitely be sharing this company with others who need pool resurfacing work done.  Thank you to Custom Pools/ Davidson Pools!  Gil and Ann Sims
reviews.author: Gilbert Sims

reviews.text:
You will not find many ratings regarding M&R Plastering, but I can assure you that there is no harder working, honest and loyal folks out there. I saved about $1,890 with them.
These guys were quick, efficient and I could not be happier with my pool remodel.
My neighbor also used them shortly after I did, and she has handed their info out and I smile when I see them out in my neighborhood.
reviews.author: Promises Promises

reviews.text: We paid to have a pool resurfaced to eliminate a crack.  Within 4 months the crack was back and within one year the crack was larger and longer than before.    Supposedly there was a 2 year warranty but I guess that’s not the truth.  No one responds within a timely manner and refuses to resurface the pool and cut the crack out correctly!   Avoid this company at all cost!
reviews.author: Cheryl Webb

reviews.text: Attention to detail and timeliness was second to none.
reviews.author: Darryl Court

reviews.text: Great service
reviews.author: Salvador Franco

data.summary: The reviews present a mixed but concerning picture. The company is long-established with a good BBB rating, but the Google reviews show a stark pattern: a cluster of very positive reviews from June contrast with two detailed, serious complaints about warranty failure and major defects. The negative reviews are highly specific and allege a failure to stand behind their work, which is a significant red flag. The positive reviews, while numerous, lack granular detail and cluster in time, raising questions about authenticity.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews posted in same month (June)
Overly effusive, similar language in positive reviews (e.g., 'highly recommend', naming owners)
Lack of specific project details in many 5-star reviews

negative_evidence: Refused to resurface pool correctly per warranty
Stopped accepting calls after attempted fixes

authentic_signals: Specific negative complaints with details (crack issues, $35k cost, 2-year warranty)
Varied writing styles in negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: No significant rating discrepancies; BBB A+ and Google 4.6 are consistent for a long-established business. Lack of Yelp reviews is common for niche contractors.
